verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents an official flyctl MCP server ('fly mcp' with a 'Start a flyctl MCP server' subcommand), so agents can connect to the platform through a first-party MCP server, but it is explicitly marked experimental and the evidence gives only command headings. Hosting third-party MCP servers on Machines or Sprites is a separate hosting capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: a stable (non-experimental) server, documentation of the tools/operations exposed to agents, setup and authentication details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
